params.placeholder: Describe one behavior, or leave blank to let the workflow choose

cloud.reason: Test-first implementation is self-contained when the project's tests run without VPN or private services.

workflows.name: UI Backend Scalability Audit
workflows.description: Trace UI actions to backend calls, identify request and data growth risks, verify evidence, and rank scalable fixes without changing application code.

params.placeholder: entire UI codebase, src/pages, billing dashboard...

params.label: Backend source path (optional)
params.placeholder: not provided, or an available backend checkout path

params.label: Expected scale or performance budgets
params.placeholder: concurrent users, records per tenant, rows per page, request or latency budgets...

inputs.scaleContext: unknown; derive bounds from code and label workload assumptions

cloud.reason: Audits repository evidence without requiring a running service; marks missing backend and runtime evidence explicitly.

workflows.name: UI Declarative Split
workflows.description: Measure how much of a UI codebase is declarative versus imperative, weighted by lines, with the imperative share separated into necessary escape hatches and avoidable ones.

params.label: UI source root
params.placeholder: src (default) — a directory or glob containing the UI code

params.label: Maximum files to score
params.placeholder: 120 (default) — beyond this the largest files are scored and the rest are estimated from the census

cloud.reason: Static reading of the checked-out repository only; the census uses git and grep, and the result is a report.
